title: A new work order for a customer with no default bills that customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Save the new work order.
  5. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is picked.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The new work order opens.

Step 5:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R6: “A new work order or part sale starts billed to the customer's saved default, if any, else the customer itself.”
